headlines.label: Overtakes
headlines.detail: On track after lap 1 · most: HAM (12)

summary: Lando Norris won the Mexico City Grand Prix from pole position, 30.3s ahead of Charles Leclerc, with Max Verstappen completing the podium.
Gabriel Bortoleto made the biggest climb, from P16 to P10.
Carlos Sainz had a day to forget, dropping from P12 to P17.
The race was neutralised by 1 virtual safety car.
The stewards penalised HAM (10 second time penalty), SAI (5 second time penalty) and SAI (drive through penalty).
There were 27 pit stops in total; the winner stopped once.
Lando Norris takes the championship lead, 1 points ahead of Oscar Piastri.
